ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹4,000 to ₹10,000 per year in two installments (Kharif and Rabi) for cultivation, plus ₹2,00,000 life insurance cover for farmers aged 18-60.
exclusions: Non-cultivators without RoR (Porcha), Patta, or registered Bargadar record
documents_required: Record of Rights (RoR / Porcha) or Bargadar Certificate
application_steps: Visit a Duare Sarkar camp or Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) Block Office in West Bengal.
Submit the Krishak Bandhu enrollment form with land Porcha and bank passbook.
